thread:
Elaine Harper: Quick heads-up — OklaLog (pilot) showing ~60% drop in generation calls over the last 7 days. Matt (PO) left last week; new engineering lead Priya is taking over and told our AE they're doing a broader stack evaluation. Renewal in 6 weeks. Need risk triage and next steps.

Raj Patel: Oof. Can you paste the top-level metrics (calls, tokens, error rate)? Any recent changelogs or infra errors?

Elaine Harper: Pulling numbers now. Quick snapshot:
```
last_7d: calls - 1,820 (was 4,600 previous 7d)
last_7d: tokens - 4.6M (was 12.1M)
error_rate: 0.9% (was 0.3%)
avg_latency: 420ms (was 310ms)
```
No config rollouts on our side in that window. They did switch to a smaller batch config in their app last Wed (AE notes).

Jordan Li: Support ticket #4532 opened by Matt on Mar 3: seen `timeout while waiting for kv cache` and occasional 429s from their side. Paste of the last 5 errors: `timeout`, `rate_limit`, `context-length-exceed` x2, `connection_reset`. I re-run the repro request and see lat spikes at ~800ms for longer prompts.

Marta Gomez: Thanks — two quick priorities: 1) Re-engage Priya to understand their evaluation criteria (latency vs cost vs model quality). 2) Offer a tactical perf/cost audit for their top 10 flows and a short remediation plan. I can own a 1-hr deep-dive if we get time on their calendar.

Elaine Harper: Agreed. Also we should surface a comparison vs the competitor they're testing — ask Priya what they care about (p50/p95, token cost, SLA). If they're worried about cost we can show batching + kv cache uplift.

Raj Patel: I can draft outreach to Priya. Proposed message: "Hi Priya — I'm Raj from Redwood CS. Noticed your usage drop. Can we do a short audit + walkthrough this week? We'll bring a cost/latency analysis and quick wins to recover throughput." Good?

Elaine Harper: Perfect. Add a suggested time slot: Thu 10am PT or Fri 2pm PT.

Jordan Li: I'll escalate ticket #4532 to infra and run a quick KV cache warm run against their top prompt set. Also will check whether their client dropped to `sync` mode which would reduce throughput.

Marta Gomez: Prep checklist for deep-dive:
- ask Priya for top 10 flows + sample prompts
- notes on batch settings + recent app change (they mentioned smaller batch)
- quick golden config with ETA to implement (batching + prefix caching)
- cost delta before/after (estimated)

Elaine Harper: Good checklist. Also flag to sales: renewal checkpoint in 6 weeks — may need AE to join if procurement accelerates.

Raj Patel: Draft outreach posted in #drafts: "Priya — quick audit offer (Thu 10am PT / Fri 2pm PT). We'll include a short perf/cost slide and follow-up action items." Posting now.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: autoscaler v2 rolled out to prod at 2067890600 — no customer-facing changes expected.

Elaine Harper: Thanks team. Action items: Raj outreach owner, Jordan infra triage, Marta deep-dive if accepted. I'll loop AE and attach renewal timeline to the calendar. Will update thread after outreach. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: Outreach sent to Priya (cc Elaine, AE). Got automated reply: "Thanks — looking for short audit. Can do Fri afternoon." Marking Fri 2pm PT tentative.

Jordan Li: Infra update: KV cache warm run completed, latency p95 improved by 120ms in our test harness. I attached steps for client to re-enable async batching (they had `max_batch_size: 1`).

Marta Gomez: Great. I'll assemble the 15-min audit slide deck and cost sketch for Fri.

Elaine Harper: Nice work. Will sync after Fri session and decide whether we need an interim pilot extension or offer a limited Dedicated trial for their highest-volume route.

Raj Patel: Reaction: :rocket:

Jordan Li: Reaction: :white_check_mark:

Elaine Harper: Will follow up with outcomes in this thread after the call.
